turbinate-reduction.text: Users look at turbinate reduction as a companion to septoplasty or rhinoplasty, so the nose both breathes well and can be reshaped. It is a functional operation rather than a cosmetic one, and forum posters debate its trade-offs, including empty nose syndrome. Evidence covers airway outcomes, not appearance.

nasal-valve-repair.text: Nasal valve repair is discussed by people planning rhinoplasty who want a nose that is both well shaped and open for breathing, since a collapsing valve can narrow the sidewalls. It is a functional rhinoplasty technique studied mainly in case series reporting airway improvement.

ultrasonic-piezo-rhinoplasty.text: Piezo rhinoplasty is promoted as a way to reshape the nasal bones precisely, with a straighter or lower bridge as the visible result. The reshaping is visible once swelling settles. Evidence for its advantages over chisels and rasps is mostly descriptive, from surgeon reviews.

preservation-rhinoplasty.text: Preservation rhinoplasty is sought by people who want a smaller dorsal hump or a straighter profile while keeping their natural bridge lines. The visible profile change is the goal of the operation itself. Surgeon reports are mostly case series, with claims of favourable aesthetic results.

revision-rhinoplasty.text: Revision rhinoplasty is discussed by people unhappy with a first nose job who want shape or breathing problems corrected, often with cartilage grafts. The corrected shape is visible after healing. Revision rates of roughly 5 to 20 percent are documented in surgical references.

alar-base-reduction-alarplasty.text: Alarplasty is used to narrow wide nostrils or a broad nose base, usually alongside rhinoplasty, and the narrower base is visible once healed. Forum posters debate how much change a given face needs. Trial evidence specific to alarplasty is limited.

tip-plasty-cartilage-grafting.text: Tip plasty is used to refine a bulbous, drooping or under-projected nasal tip with sutures, cartilage trimming or grafts, and the new tip shape is visible after healing. It is described as a technically demanding part of rhinoplasty and is supported by technique papers rather than large trials.

rib-cartilage-graft-rhinoplasty.text: Rib cartilage grafts are discussed by people who need substantial structural material for major nose rebuilds, such as dorsal reconstruction or revision surgery, using their own tissue. The rebuilt shape is visible after healing. Evidence comes mainly from surgical case series.

silicone-gore-tex-nasal-implant.text: Silicone and Gore-Tex implants are used to raise a low nasal bridge, particularly in Asian rhinoplasty, as an alternative to the patient's own cartilage. The added bridge height is immediately visible. The literature consists mainly of surgical series and comparisons.

septal-extension-graft.text: A septal extension graft is used in rhinoplasty to set the tip's position, projection and rotation, especially when the lower lateral cartilages are weak. The tip change is visible after healing. It is an established technique, with comparative data growing.

pdo-nose-thread-lift.text: PDO thread lifts are promoted as a non-surgical way to raise the nasal bridge or tip, sometimes combined with filler, with the lift visible soon after treatment. The result is temporary as the threads absorb. Published evidence is very limited.

botox-nose-tip-lift.text: Proponents use botulinum toxin in the depressor septi nasi muscle as a short-term way to lift a drooping tip, especially one that drops when smiling. It is an off-label use with temporary results, and no published trials have tested it.

chain: Dark shade on sides, light on bridge
nose-contouring-makeup.text: Contouring makeup is used to make the nose look slimmer, straighter or more defined for the day, and the optical effect is visible straight away and washes off. It applies general contouring methods to the nose, and no studies have tested it specifically.

nasal-taping-at-night.text: Social-media users wear micropore or kinesiology tape on the nose overnight as a non-surgical mini nose job for a slimmer or lifted look. Claims of gradual cartilage remodelling are anecdotal, and surgeons describe any effect as fading when the tape is removed.

nose-lifting-or-slimming-massage.text: Beauty communities describe daily nose rubbing or pinching as a free, non-surgical way to slim or lift the nose. The claimed reshaping rests on anecdote, and no studies have tested it.

nose-exercises-nose-yoga.text: Nose exercises, part of face yoga, are promoted to strengthen nasal muscles and change nostril or tip shape through flaring, scrunching and pressing. The reshaping claim rests on anecdote, and no studies have tested it.

chain: Better breathing habits, claimed facial benefit
buteyko-breathing.text: Buteyko is a breathing-retraining method that users in looksmaxxing circles connect with nasal breathing, mouth taping and the idea that breathing habits shape the face. Trials in asthma show modest symptom effects, and none test facial appearance.

rhinophyma-laser-surgery.text: Rhinophyma laser or surgical shaving is a recognised clinical treatment that removes the thickened tissue of advanced rosacea to restore a normal nose contour, with the change visible after healing. It is a medical procedure that appearance communities mention, not a looksmaxxing invention.

chain: Choose surgery or jaw changes to fix
nasofrontal-nasolabial-angle-theory.text: Forum users borrow nasofrontal and nasolabial angle measurements from rhinoplasty and orthodontics to score side profiles and plan brow, nose or jaw changes. The angles are standard clinical measures, while the claim that they drive attractiveness comes mostly from community opinion.

rhinoplasty-simulation-apps.text: Clinics and prospective patients use morphing and 3D imaging software to preview how a nose might look after surgery and to align expectations with the surgeon. The preview image is visible immediately. The actual surgical outcome is not guaranteed to match it.

chain: Home filing or striking of bump
dorsal-hump-rasping-diy.text: Some posters discuss filing or striking a nasal bump at home to flatten the bridge. The wiki's sources do not document how common this is or its methods, and surgical literature describes hump reduction as a surgeon-performed procedure.

nasal-splint-after-rhinoplasty.text: After rhinoplasty, surgeons apply tape and a splint to keep the reshaped nose stable while it heals, usually removed after about one week. Patients and forum posters discuss it as part of protecting the surgical result.

nasal-irrigation.text: Looksmaxxing interest in saline nasal rinsing centres on clearing congestion to support nasal breathing, which some link to sleep and face habits. It is an established hygiene and medical practice, and no studies have looked at its effect on nose appearance.

lip-flip-botox.text: A lip flip is used to make a thin upper lip look fuller by showing more pink lip without adding volume, with the change visible within days. Results are temporary and reversible. Support comes from small studies.

lip-lift-bullhorn-subnasal.text: A lip lift is used by people with a long philtrum who want to show more pink lip and improve upper-lip proportions, with a permanent change visible once healed. The scar is hidden under the nose in the bullhorn version. Evidence is mainly surgical series.

fat-grafting-lips.text: Lip fat grafting is used to add lasting volume with the patient's own tissue, with a fuller lip visible once swelling settles. Some of the fat is reabsorbed over time. It is described as one of the better semi-permanent options.

lip-implants-permalip-gore-tex.text: Lip implants made of Gore-Tex or silicone (Permalip) are chosen by people who want permanent lip volume, and the fuller lip is visible after healing. They are discussed alongside fillers and fat grafting as the durable option.

lip-reduction-surgery.text: Lip reduction is used by people who feel very full lips are out of balance with the rest of the face, and the smaller lips are visible after healing. The literature covers it mainly for medical conditions such as macrocheilia, with little cosmetic research.

v-y-advancement-vermilion-advancement.text: Vermilion advancement is discussed as a way to increase pink lip show, and the repositioned lip is visible after healing. In the literature it is mostly a reconstructive method, for example after tumour removal, with little cosmetic research.

lip-blushing-cosmetic-tattoo.text: Lip blushing is used as a semi-permanent alternative to tinted lip balm for people who describe their lip color as uneven or pale, and the tint is visible once healed. Documentation is mostly case reports of reactions, with no appearance trials.
